Mounting Headwinds For US Assets

Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research | 9 Nov 2026

The point of the Daily reports is to review important data releases, geopolitical events and market movements, and to explain whether these confirm or negate the narrative presented elsewhere in the research. With that in mind, the running theme of our research for the past few years has been that the age of massive US outperformance was drawing to an end, and that the surge higher in US relative performance which accompanied Donald Trump’s 2024 election victory was probably an exponential “blow-off top” that is fairly typical of climactic bull markets. The question now confronting us is whether recent events will revive US outperformance? Or stall it?
